business_problem: Guotai Junan Securities wanted to improve multilingual communication, digitize remote onboarding and identity-verification workflows, and automate routine IT operations instead of relying on manual translation, document entry, and repetitive operations work.
solution_summary: Guotai Junan Securities used Tencent Cloud to modernize both client-facing and internal operations workflows with a mix of AI services and private deployment. Tencent Cloud's machine translation stack supports text, image, voice, and simultaneous interpretation so overseas clients and employees can communicate without manual translation bottlenecks. A privately deployed OCR text-recognition service digitizes IDs, business cards, and forms for online securities workflows, while liveness detection adds identity-verification controls to account opening and remote processing. In the operations layer, BlueKing automates unattended basic services and gives the firm a PaaS-style toolkit for building custom operations utilities. Together the stack turns multilingual communication, onboarding, and operations work into reusable digital services instead of disconnected manual tasks.

solution_components.name: Machine Translation
solution_components.role: Translates text, images, speech, and simultaneous interpretation content for cross-language communication.

solution_components.name: OCR Text Recognition
solution_components.role: Extracts text from IDs, business cards, and forms so securities workflows can be digitized.

solution_components.name: Liveness Detection
solution_components.role: Adds anti-spoofing identity verification to online account-opening and remote business handling.

solution_components.name: BlueKing
solution_components.role: Automates routine operations services and lets teams assemble custom tools on top of a PaaS foundation.

data_flow: Speech, text, image, and ID inputs enter machine translation, OCR, and liveness services before feeding onboarding, identity verification, and multilingual operations workflows; BlueKing then orchestrates repetitive IT tasks and service automation around those business processes.
business_outcome: The program reduced translation friction for overseas collaboration, improved online identity handling and customer experience, and raised operations efficiency by replacing repetitive manual work with automated tooling.
metrics: The machine-translation service supports mutual translation across more than 10 languages.
architecture_clues: OCR was deployed in a private environment.
The onboarding flow uses ID-card recognition, bank-card recognition, and liveness detection.
BlueKing contributes a PaaS layer for building custom operations tools and systems.
evidence_quotes: Guotai Junan hoped to use AI to deliver simultaneous interpretation across different languages and to use mature OCR and liveness-detection technology to transform online business handling. (original: 希望通过应用 AI 技术来实现不同语种之间的同声传译，提升沟通效率。此外，国泰君安还希望应用成熟的 OCR 文字识别和活体检测技术来改造传统的线上业务办理流程。)

Tencent Cloud provided a machine-translation solution that supports language identification, text translation, image translation, speech translation, and simultaneous interpretation. (original: 腾讯云为国泰君安提供了翻译君机器翻译解决方案...支持语种识别、文本翻译、图片翻译、语音翻译、同声传译等多项功能。)

Tencent Cloud also provided privately deployed OCR text detection and recognition products that support identity cards, business cards, bills, and waybills. (original: 腾讯云还向国泰君安提供了私有化部署的 OCR 文字识别图文字检测和识别产品...包括身份证、名片等卡证类，也支持票据、运单等定制化场景的识别。)

In intelligent operations, Guotai Junan adopted Tencent BlueKing to solve daily operations problems, improve efficiency, and quickly build tools and systems. (original: 智能运维领域，国泰君安采用了腾讯蓝鲸解决方案...帮助运维人员解决日常运维问题，提升运维效率，还提供强大的 PaaS 服务，帮助运维人员快速构建运维工具和系统。)
OCR and liveness-detection deployment improved customer experience and the success rate of business processing. (original: 通过OCR 文字识别和活体检测技术的部署和应用，引入了身份证识别、银行卡识别、活体检测等算法能力...有效提升了客户体验和业务办理成功率。)
